# Spray Foam Science

> The building science behind spray foam insulation — chemistry, R-value and thermal performance, off-ratio and cure science, moisture and vapor barrier physics, the reputation/resale concerns and their real root causes, DIY vs professional application, and fire/code compliance. Backed by Contractors Choice Agency's 20+ years of contractor experience.

Spray Foam Science is an educational resource, not a sales page — content covers failure modes and limitations honestly alongside genuine performance benefits, with no fabricated statistics or claims. It softly connects readers to CCA's certified installer network once they've had a chance to understand the science.

## Topics
- [Open-Cell vs. Closed-Cell Chemistry](https://www.sprayfoamscience.com/topics/open-cell-vs-closed-cell-chemistry)
- [R-Value & Real-World Thermal Performance](https://www.sprayfoamscience.com/topics/r-value-thermal-performance)
- [Why Spray Foam Becomes a "Red Flag" — The Reputation Science](https://www.sprayfoamscience.com/topics/why-spray-foam-becomes-a-red-flag)
- [Off-Ratio & Improper Cure Science](https://www.sprayfoamscience.com/topics/off-ratio-improper-cure-science)
- [Moisture & Vapor Barrier Physics](https://www.sprayfoamscience.com/topics/moisture-vapor-barrier-physics)
- [DIY Kits vs. Professional Application](https://www.sprayfoamscience.com/topics/diy-kits-vs-professional-application)
- [Fire & Code Compliance Science](https://www.sprayfoamscience.com/topics/fire-code-compliance-science)
